global_negative_prompt: Do not include modern objects or clothing
Do not include clean vector art
Do not include letters, words, numerals, captions, logos, signatures, or watermarks
Do not include an unrequested frame, unrequested border, user-interface control, or baked typography
Do not include unrequested objects, limbs, weapons, architecture, or terrain
Do not include camera-facing highlights or a directional light gradient that conflicts with runtime lighting
name: Realmz Remastered painterly dark-fantasy style proof
preservation_contract: Treat the individual decoded Classic PNG as the sole visual reference for its job; never use the combined contact sheet as model input.
Preserve subject identity, pose, facing, silhouette, count, gameplay function, palette role, landmarks, and mood.
Preserve the original logical footprint, anchor, mask intent, and visible-tile behavior; increased master resolution must not reveal more terrain.
Do not add text. Typography, controls, focus rings, hit regions, masks, hotspots, sprite order, and nine-slice assembly remain code-native.
Do not copy pixel noise or invent detail that changes gameplay readability.
scope: Twenty-one generation-eligible core and Tutorial references in the pre-generation style proof; authorized City replacements are not present and are outside this spec.
style_prompt: A cohesive painterly dark-fantasy game illustration, hand-painted in appearance with confident brushwork, weathered natural materials, restrained detail, strong readable silhouettes at gameplay scale, a somber medieval atmosphere, and selective jewel-toned accents against charcoal, slate, earth, and aged-metal neutrals. Preserve the reference's functional color hierarchy and late-1990s fantasy-adventure mood while increasing clarity and material richness for a modern high-density macOS display.

visual_language.edges: Painterly and controlled; crisp enough at the silhouette and gameplay-significant internal boundaries, softer only in nonfunctional interior detail.
visual_language.lighting: Low-key ambient fantasy lighting. No global directional highlight or shadow may be baked into reusable UI, terrain, actor, item, or spell masters; only semantically emitted flame, magic, and scene-local illustration light are allowed.
visual_language.materials: Weathered stone, dark iron, worn leather, cloth, wood, earth, water, and magical energy should remain distinguishable without photoreal surface noise.
visual_language.palette: Charcoal, slate blue, deep umber, muted moss, cold steel, parchment, and restrained violet, cyan, amber, and crimson accents keyed to the Classic source.
visual_language.tone: Serious, mysterious, adventurous, and slightly ominous; never glossy, whimsical, cute, or heroic-poster bombastic.
